exercises.why: **счастливо** — happily (in a happy manner). Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**ме́дленно** — slowly. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (colloquial) evidently, obviously, apparently, it looks like
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: осо́бенно — especially; ви́дно — (colloquial) evidently, obviously, apparently, it looks like; счастливо — happily (in a happy manner); ме́дленно — slowly.
**действи́тельно** — really, actually, truly, indeed. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**равно́** — equally, as well, as well as. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**ве́рно** — right, correctly. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**споко́йно** — calmly, quietly. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: equally, as well, as well as
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: действи́тельно — really, actually, truly, indeed; равно́ — equally, as well, as well as; ве́рно — right, correctly; споко́йно — calmly, quietly.
